title: Two '(as an Envoy)' options were guaranteed no-ops against NPCs explicitly written as charm-proof: the hunter ('Wood doesn't care how well a thing's said... Neither do I, much') and Old Crick ('Save it for someone who wasn't already digging in the dark before you were born'). Both cost nothing but returned only 1xp and a flavor line, with no way to tell in advance that these two — unlike every other Envoy option I tried — would be inert.
where: Hunter's Camp / 'turn your best charm on him (as an Envoy)'; The Miners' Hall (Cinderhall) / 'turn on the charm (Envoy)'
